prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: blank illustrated letter paper background for a Japanese fantasy reading quest UI.
Primary request: a real illustrated sheet of stationery, seen perfectly straight-on, no perspective. A warm ivory handmade paper sheet with slightly uneven softly worn edges, subtle folded creases, small folded upper-right corner, and a small burgundy wax seal with a simple open-book emblem at the extreme lower-right corner. Charming polished fantasy RPG stationery, gentle hand-painted game illustration. Restrained tan edges, pale cream center, soft natural paper fibers. No dark stains or burned edges.
Composition: square canvas, the sheet nearly fills it with only 1% transparent margin. All distinctive details stay within the outermost 6% edge strip so the image can be used as a nine-slice resizable UI panel. The entire central 88% must be blank, very pale, clean and low contrast for long Japanese text to be overlaid. Seal small and entirely within the lower-right 6% corner. Top and bottom edge strips should connect seamlessly when stretched. Very subtle horizontal fold lines only, do not compete with text.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background outside paper, no environment, no desk, no envelope, no quill, no separate objects, no writing, no letters, no typography, no ruling, no watermark. Complete sheet visible, no crop. High quality usable bitmap game asset.
